reference_config.emulator: mesen-agent 0.1.0 defaults (NTSC, square pixels, default palette)
reference_config.frame_phase: endFrame at scanline 240 cycle 0 observed in prep runs; per-frame RAM snapshot via Lua at same hook
reference_config.determinism: from reset, frames 0-3 contain power-on RAM garbage not yet cleared; frames >=4 byte-identical across runs incl. final.mss, PNG, WAV

determinism_check.result: identical from frame 4 onward (ram/palette/oam), identical final.mss/PNG/WAV; frames 0-3 differ only in uncleared power-on RAM

rules: Golden comparisons start at frame >= 4 or from a snapshot
ROM is immutable; record_reference.py asserts sha256 each run
